mapper.select: SELECT pay50_expense_id AS expense_id, pay50_company_id AS company_id, pay50_expense_cd AS expense_code, pay50_expense_nm AS expense_name, pay50_reg_emp_id AS reg_emp_id, pay50_reg_emp_org_nm AS reg_emp_org_name, pay50_reg_date AS reg_date, pay50_occ_date AS occ_date, pay50_desc AS "desc", pay50_settle_amt AS settle_amt, pay50_due_date AS due_date, pay50_corp_id AS corp_id, pay50_corp_nm AS corp_name, pay50_floral_id AS floral_id FROM ( ---------------------------------------- -- 사업비요청 ---------------------------------------- SELECT pay50_expense_id , pay50_company_id , pay50_expense_cd , f_cdnm('ExpenseType', pay50_expense_cd, pay50_company_id, pay50_reg_date) AS pay50_expense_nm , pay50_reg_emp_id , f_get_empTrans(pay50_reg_emp_id , pay50_reg_date, 'person_org_info') AS pay50_reg_emp_org_nm , pay50_reg_date , pay50_occ_date , pay50_desc , pay50_settle_amt , pay50_due_date , pay50_corp_id , COALESCE(sys15_corp_nm, f_emp_kor_nm(pay50_corp_id)) AS pay50_corp_nm , null AS pay50_floral_id FROM pay50_expense LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = pay50_corp_id WHERE pay50_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay50_confirm_status_cd = '20' /*(20:승인)*/ AND pay50_appr_emp_id IS NULL ---------------------------------------- -- 화환신청 ---------------------------------------- UNION ALL SELECT row_number() over() AS pay50_expense_id , bbs20_company_id AS pay50_company_id , '20' AS pay50_expense_cd , f_cdnm('ExpenseType', '20', bbs20_company_id, bbs20_reg_date) AS pay50_expense_nm , bbs20_person_id AS pay50_reg_emp_id , f_get_empTrans(bbs20_person_id , bbs20_reg_date, 'person_org_info') AS pay50_reg_emp_org_nm , bbs20_reg_date AS pay50_reg_date , bbs20_end_date AS pay50_occ_date , CONCAT(f_cdnm('OccasionsCode',bbs20_occasions_cd,bbs20_company_id,bbs20_reg_date) ,' - '||bbs20_rcv_company ,' '||bbs20_rcv_emp ,'('||bbs20_reason||')') AS pay50_desc , null AS pay50_settle_amt , null AS pay50_due_date , null AS pay50_corp_id , null AS pay50_corp_nm , bbs20_floral_request_id AS pay50_floral_id FROM bbs20_floral_request WHERE bbs20_company_id = #{companyId} AND bbs20_status_cd = '92' /*(20:접수/92:발송완료)*/ AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pay50_expense WHERE pay50_floral_id = bbs20_floral_request_id ) ) t WHERE CONCAT(pay50_reg_emp_org_nm, pay50_expense_nm, pay50_desc, pay50_corp_nm) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY pay50_occ_date DESC

SELECT FROM ( SELECT pay50.* , f_cdnm('ExpenseType' , pay50_expense_cd , pay50_company_id, f_today()) AS pay50_expense_nm , f_cdnm('TaxType' , pay50_tax_type , pay50_company_id, f_today()) AS pay50_tax_type_nm , f_cdnm('PayMethodCode' , pay50_pay_method_cd , pay50_company_id, f_today()) AS pay50_pay_method_nm , f_get_account_nm(pay50_company_id, pay50_account_cd) AS pay50_account_nm , ast1.ast01_class_tree_nm AS pay50_deposit_nm , ast2.ast01_class_tree_nm AS pay50_ast_nm , f_get_empTrans(pay50_reg_emp_id , f_today(), 'person_org_info') AS pay50_reg_emp_org_nm , f_get_empTrans(pay50_appr_emp_id , f_today(), 'person_org_info') AS pay50_appr_emp_org_nm , f_get_empTrans(pay50_confirmer_id , pay50_reg_date, 'person_org_info') AS pay50_confirmer_org_nm , f_get_empTrans(pay50_reg_emp_id , pay50_reg_date, 'org_code_nm') AS pay50_org_nm , COALESCE(sys15_corp_nm, f_emp_kor_nm(pay50_corp_id)) AS pay50_corp_nm , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = pay50_expense_id ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com01_relate_appr WHERE com01_key_table_id = pay50_expense_id ) ||'건' AS pay50_file_count_str , CASE WHEN pay50_appr_emp_id IS NULL THEN '' ELSE (CASE WHEN COALESCE(apr1.apr01_status_cd,'99') = '30' THEN '완료' WHEN COALESCE(apr1.apr01_status_cd,'99') = '40' OR COALESCE(pay50_reject_reason,'') != '' THEN '반려' ELSE '진행중' END) END AS pay50_expense_status_nm , apr1.apr01_title AS pay50_expense_appr_title , apr1.apr01_status_cd AS pay50_expense_appr_status_cd , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr1.apr01_status_cd, pay50_company_id, f_today()) AS pay50_expense_appr_status_nm FROM pay50_expense pay50 LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = pay50_corp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr apr1 ON apr1.apr01_appr_id = pay50_expense_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree ast1 ON ast1.ast01_class_tree_id = pay50_deposit_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree ast2 ON ast2.ast01_class_tree_id = pay50_ast_id WHERE pay50_expense_id = #{expenseId} AND pay50_company_id = #{companyId} ) t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay50_expense ( pay50_expense_id, pay50_company_id, pay50_expense_cd, pay50_reg_emp_id, pay50_reg_date, pay50_occ_date, pay50_desc, pay50_confirmer_id, pay50_confirm_status_cd, pay50_confirm_date, pay50_appr_emp_id, pay50_floral_id, pay50_pay_method_cd ) VALUES ( #{expenseId}, #{companyId}, #{row.expenseCode}, #{row.regEmpId}, #{row.regDate}, #{row.occDate}, #{row.desc}, #{apprEmpId}, '20', #{row.occDate}, #{apprEmpId}, #{row.floralId}, '10' )

SELECT pay50_expense_id AS expense_id, pay50_company_id AS company_id, pay50_expense_cd AS expense_code, pay50_expense_nm AS expense_name, pay50_desc AS "desc", pay50_corp_id AS corp_id, pay50_corp_nm AS corp_name, pay50_tel AS tel, pay50_addr AS addr, pay50_due_date AS due_date, pay50_settle_amt AS settle_amt, pay50_pay_method_cd AS pay_method_code, pay50_pay_method_nm AS pay_method_name, pay50_pay_account_info AS pay_account_info, pay50_settle_date AS settle_date, pay50_deposit_id AS deposit_id, pay50_deposit_nm AS deposit_name, pay50_settle_note AS settle_note, pay50_journal_id AS journal_id, pay50_expense_appr_id AS expense_appr_id, pay50_expense_appr_status_cd AS expense_appr_status_code, pay50_settle_appr_id AS settle_appr_id, pay50_settle_appr_status_cd AS settle_appr_status_code, pay50_settle_appr_status_nm AS settle_appr_status_name, pay50_pay_yn AS pay_yn
FROM ( SELECT pay50.* , f_cdnm('ExpenseType' , pay50_expense_cd , pay50_company_id, pay50_due_date) AS pay50_expense_nm , f_cdnm('TaxType' , pay50_tax_type , pay50_company_id, pay50_due_date) AS pay50_tax_type_nm , f_cdnm('PayMethodCode' , pay50_pay_method_cd , pay50_company_id, pay50_due_date) AS pay50_pay_method_nm , f_cdnm('StatusCode' , pay50_confirm_status_cd , pay50_company_id, pay50_due_date) AS pay50_confirm_status_nm , f_get_account_nm(pay50_company_id, pay50_account_cd) AS pay50_account_nm , ast01_class_tree_nm AS pay50_deposit_nm , f_get_empTrans(pay50_reg_emp_id , pay50_due_date, 'person_org_info') AS pay50_reg_emp_org_nm , f_get_empTrans(pay50_appr_emp_id , pay50_due_date, 'person_org_info') AS pay50_appr_emp_org_nm , f_get_empTrans(pay50_settle_emp_id, pay50_due_date, 'person_org_info') AS pay50_settle_emp_org_nm , f_get_empTrans(pay50_reg_emp_id, pay50_reg_date, 'org_code_nm') AS pay50_org_nm , COALESCE(sys15_corp_nm, f_emp_kor_nm(pay50_corp_id)) AS pay50_corp_nm , sys15_tel AS pay50_tel , sys15_addr AS pay50_addr , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = pay50_expense_id ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com01_relate_appr WHERE com01_key_table_id = pay50_expense_id ) ||'건' AS pay50_file_count_str , CASE WHEN pay50_appr_emp_id IS NULL THEN '' ELSE (CASE WHEN COALESCE(apr1.apr01_status_cd,'99') = '30' THEN '완료' WHEN COALESCE(apr1.apr01_status_cd,'99') = '40' OR COALESCE(pay50_reject_reason,'') != '' THEN '반려' ELSE '진행중' END) END AS pay50_expense_status_nm , CASE WHEN pay_amt = pay50_settle_amt THEN '완료' ELSE (CASE WHEN COALESCE(apr2.apr01_status_cd,'99') = '99' THEN '' WHEN COALESCE(apr2.apr01_status_cd,'99') = '40' THEN '반려' ELSE '진행중' END) END AS pay50_settle_status_nm , apr1.apr01_title AS pay50_expense_appr_title , apr1.apr01_status_cd AS pay50_expense_appr_status_cd , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr1.apr01_status_cd, pay50_company_id, pay50_due_date) AS pay50_expense_appr_status_nm , apr2.apr01_title AS pay50_settle_appr_title , apr2.apr01_status_cd AS pay50_settle_appr_status_cd , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr2.apr01_status_cd, pay50_company_id, pay50_due_date) AS pay50_settle_appr_status_nm , CASE WHEN (pay50_settle_amt = pay_amt AND apr2.apr01_status_cd = '30') THEN true ELSE false END AS pay50_pay_yn FROM ( SELECT pay50_expense.* , CASE WHEN COALESCE(ast06_settle_mng_yn,'true') = 'false' THEN pay50_settle_amt ELSE COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ast07_for_amt) FROM ast07_settle WHERE ast07_expense_id = pay50_expense_id),0) END as pay_amt FROM pay50_expense LEFT OUTER JOIN ast06_tr ON ( ast06_expense_id = pay50_expense_id AND ast06_tr_cd IN ( SELECT ast15_tr_cd FROM ast15_tr_code_window WHERE ast15_company_id = ast06_company_id AND ast15_window_class_nm = 'Ast06_Tab_TrTax' /*(세금/4대보험 발생회계는 ast06 정보로 생성함)*/ AND ast15_tr_cd IS NOT NULL ) ) WHERE pay50_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay50_settle_emp_id IS NOT NULL AND pay50_due_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND pay50_expense_cd LIKE #{expenseCode} ) pay50 INNER JOIN apr01_appr apr1 ON apr1.apr01_appr_id = pay50_expense_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr apr2 ON apr2.apr01_appr_id = pay50_settle_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ast01_class_tree_id = pay50_deposit_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = pay50_corp_id WHERE 1=1 AND apr1.apr01_status_cd = '30' /*(30:결재완료)*/
AND ( ( #{payYnCode} = 'Y' AND pay_amt = pay50_settle_amt ) OR ( #{payYnCode} = 'N' AND pay_amt != pay50_settle_amt ) OR ( #{payYnCode} = '%' ) )
AND (COALESCE(apr2.apr01_status_cd,'99') NOT IN ('30','40') /*(30:완료/40:반려)*/ OR (apr2.apr01_status_cd = '30' AND pay50_due_date >= f_sysdate()::date))
) t WHERE CONCAT(pay50_desc, pay50_corp_nm) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY pay50_due_date, pay50_expense_id

SELECT pay50_expense_id AS expense_id, pay50_company_id AS company_id, pay50_expense_cd AS expense_code, pay50_expense_nm AS expense_name, pay50_occ_date AS occ_date, pay50_due_date AS due_date, pay50_desc AS "desc", pay50_corp_id AS corp_id, pay50_corp_nm AS corp_name, pay50_pay_method_cd AS pay_method_code, f_cdnm('PayMethodCode', pay50_pay_method_cd, pay50_company_id, pay50_due_date) AS pay_method_name, pay50_pay_account_info AS pay_account_info, pay50_tax_type AS tax_type, pay50_amt AS amt, pay50_tax AS tax, pay50_settle_amt AS settle_amt, pay50_appr_emp_id AS appr_emp_id, pay50_expense_appr_id AS expense_appr_id, pay50_benefit_id AS benefit_id, pay50_transport_std_ym AS transport_std_ym, pay50_biz_card_std_ym AS biz_card_std_ym, pay50_biz_card_corp_cd AS biz_card_corp_code, pay50_deposit_id AS deposit_id, pay50_settle_date AS settle_date, pay50_account_cd AS account_code, pay50_account_nm AS account_name, pay50_tr_id AS tr_id
FROM ( ---------------------------------------- -- (신규 자금집행 예정내역) -- 10:사업비요청 -- 20:화환신청 -- 90:기타출금 -- 91:기타출금(선급) ---------------------------------------- SELECT pay50_expense_id , pay50_company_id , pay50_expense_cd , f_cdnm('ExpenseType', pay50_expense_cd, pay50_company_id, pay50_due_date) AS pay50_expense_nm , pay50_occ_date , pay50_due_date , pay50_desc , pay50_corp_id , COALESCE(sys15_corp_nm, f_emp_kor_nm(pay50_corp_id)) AS pay50_corp_nm , pay50_pay_method_cd , pay50_pay_account_info , pay50_tax_type , pay50_amt , pay50_tax , pay50_settle_amt , pay50_appr_emp_id , pay50_expense_appr_id , null AS pay50_benefit_id , null AS pay50_transport_std_ym , null AS pay50_biz_card_std_ym , null AS pay50_biz_card_corp_cd , null::numeric AS pay50_deposit_id , null::date AS pay50_settle_date , pay50_account_cd , f_get_account_nm(pay50_company_id, pay50_account_cd) AS pay50_account_nm , null::numeric AS pay50_tr_id FROM pay50_expense INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = pay50_expense_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = pay50_corp_id WHERE pay50_company_id = #{companyId} AND apr01_status_cd = '30' AND pay50_expense_cd IN ('10','20','90','91') /*(10:사업비요청/20:화환신청/90:기타출금/91:기타출금(선급))*/ AND pay50_pay_method_cd != '15' /*(15:법인카드)*/ AND ( ( #{targetType} = 'SETTLE' AND pay50_settle_emp_id IS NULL AND pay50_pay_method_cd != '17' ) OR /*(17:선급비용)은 자금집행 없음*/ ( #{targetType} = 'JOURNAL' AND pay50_journal_id IS NULL ) ) ---------------------------------------- -- 30:복리후생비 ---------------------------------------- UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(pay50_expense_id, 3000000 + row_number() over()) AS pay50_expense_id , emp17_company_id AS pay50_company_id , '30' AS pay50_expense_cd , f_cdnm('ExpenseType', '30', emp17_company_id, emp17_occ_date) AS pay50_expense_nm , COALESCE(pay50_occ_date, emp17_occ_date) AS pay50_occ_date , COALESCE(pay50_due_date, f_today()) AS pay50_due_date , COALESCE(pay50_desc ,CONCAT( f_cdnm('EmpBenefitType', emp17_benefit_cd, emp17_company_id, emp17_issue_date) , '('||emp17_benefit_detail||')' , '_'||emp17_pay_request_yyyymm )) AS pay50_desc , COALESCE(pay50_corp_id, emp17_person_id) AS pay50_corp_id , f_emp_kor_nm(COALESCE(pay50_corp_id, emp17_person_id)) AS pay50_corp_nm , COALESCE(pay50_pay_method_cd, '10') AS pay50_pay_method_cd , COALESCE(pay50_pay_account_info ,CONCAT(f_cdnm('BankCode', emp14_bank_cd, emp17_company_id, f_today()) ,' '||TO_DECRYPTS(emp14_account_no))) AS pay50_pay_account_info , '1' AS pay50_tax_type , COALESCE(pay50_settle_amt, emp17_issue_amt) AS pay50_amt , 0 AS pay50_tax , COALESCE(pay50_settle_amt, emp17_issue_amt) AS pay50_settle_amt , apr01_reg_emp_id AS pay50_appr_emp_id , emp17_pay_request_appr_id AS pay50_expense_appr_id , emp17_benefit_id AS pay50_benefit_id , null AS pay50_transport_std_ym , null AS pay50_biz_card_std_ym , null AS pay50_biz_card_corp_cd , null AS pay50_deposit_id , null AS pay50_settle_date , pay50_account_cd , f_get_account_nm(pay50_company_id, pay50_account_cd) AS pay50_account_nm , null AS pay50_tr_id FROM emp17_benefit INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = emp17_pay_request_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp14_account ON ( emp14_person_id = emp17_person_id AND emp14_start_date = (SELECT MAX(emp14_start_date) FROM emp14_account WHERE emp14_person_id = emp17_person_id AND emp14_start_date <= f_today()) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN pay50_expense ON pay50_benefit_id = emp17_benefit_id WHERE emp17_company_id = #{companyId} AND apr01_status_cd = '30' AND ( ( #{targetType} = 'SETTLE' AND pay50_settle_emp_id IS NULL ) OR ( #{targetType} = 'JOURNAL' AND pay50_journal_id IS NULL ) ) ---------------------------------------- -- 40:여비교통비 ---------------------------------------- UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(pay50_expense_id, 4000000 + row_number() over()) AS pay50_expense_id , emp52_company_id AS pay50_company_id , '40' AS pay50_expense_cd , f_cdnm('ExpenseType', '40', emp52_company_id, f_today()) AS pay50_expense_nm , COALESCE(pay50_occ_date, apr01_effect_date) AS pay50_occ_date , COALESCE(pay50_due_date, f_today()) AS pay50_due_date , COALESCE(pay50_desc, CONCAT('여비교통비', '_'||emp52_yyyymm)) AS pay50_desc , COALESCE(pay50_corp_id, emp50_person_id) AS pay50_corp_id , f_emp_kor_nm(COALESCE(pay50_corp_id, emp50_person_id)) AS pay50_corp_nm , COALESCE(pay50_pay_method_cd, '10') AS pay50_pay_method_cd , COALESCE(pay50_pay_account_info ,CONCAT(f_cdnm('BankCode', emp14_bank_cd, emp50_person_id, f_today()) ,' '||TO_DECRYPTS(emp14_account_no))) AS pay50_pay_account_info , '1' AS pay50_tax_type , COALESCE(pay50_amt , amt) AS pay50_amt , COALESCE(pay50_tax , 0) AS pay50_tax , COALESCE(pay50_settle_amt, amt) AS pay50_settle_amt , apr01_reg_emp_id AS pay50_appr_emp_id , emp52_appr_id AS pay50_expense_appr_id , null AS pay50_benefit_id , emp52_yyyymm AS pay50_transport_std_ym , null AS pay50_biz_card_std_ym , null AS pay50_biz_card_corp_cd , null AS pay50_deposit_id , null AS pay50_settle_date , pay50_account_cd , f_get_account_nm(pay50_company_id, pay50_account_cd) AS pay50_account_nm , null AS pay50_tr_id FROM ( SELECT emp52_company_id , emp52_yyyymm , emp52_appr_id , apr2.apr01_effect_date apr01_effect_date , apr2.apr01_reg_emp_id apr01_reg_emp_id , emp50_person_id , SUM(emp50_amt) amt FROM emp50_transport_expense INNER JOIN emp51_relate_appr ON ( emp51_company_id = emp50_company_id AND emp51_yyyymm = emp50_yyyymm AND emp51_person_id = emp50_person_id ) INNER JOIN emp52_relate_appr ON ( emp52_company_id = emp50_company_id AND emp52_yyyymm = emp50_yyyymm ) INNER JOIN apr01_appr apr1 ON apr1.apr01_appr_id = emp51_appr_id INNER JOIN apr01_appr apr2 ON apr2.apr01_appr_id = emp52_appr_id WHERE emp50_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp51_close_yn = 'true' AND emp50_yyyymm >= '2025.01' AND apr1.apr01_status_cd = '30' AND apr2.apr01_status_cd = '30' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pay50_expense WHERE pay50_company_id = emp52_company_id AND pay50_transport_std_ym = emp52_yyyymm AND pay50_corp_id = emp50_person_id AND pay50_expense_appr_id = emp52_appr_id AND ( ( #{targetType} = 'SETTLE' AND pay50_settle_emp_id IS NOT NULL ) OR ( #{targetType} = 'JOURNAL' AND pay50_journal_id IS NOT NULL ) ) ) GROUP BY emp52_company_id, emp52_yyyymm, emp52_appr_id, emp50_person_id , apr2.apr01_effect_date, apr2.apr01_reg_emp_id ) emp50 LEFT OUTER JOIN emp14_account ON ( emp14_person_id = emp50_person_id AND emp14_start_date = (SELECT MAX(emp14_start_date) FROM emp14_account WHERE emp14_person_id = emp50_person_id AND emp14_start_date <= f_today()) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN pay50_expense ON ( pay50_company_id = emp52_company_id AND pay50_transport_std_ym = emp52_yyyymm AND pay50_corp_id = emp50_person_id AND pay50_expense_appr_id = emp52_appr_id ) ---------------------------------------- -- 50:법인카드 ---------------------------------------- UNION ALL SELECT 5000000 + row_number() over() AS pay50_expense_id , pay50_company_id , pay50_expense_cd , f_cdnm('ExpenseType', pay50_expense_cd,
